test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

She __**told to me**__ the information.
solution:
The correct answer is '**told me**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**told**" is used when someone is relaying information to someone directly.
 
• The preposition "to" is not required after "told," making "told me" the correct form.
 
• **Options 2, 3, and 4** are grammatically incorrect in this context:
 
 
• **Option 2:** "said for me" is incorrect because "said" is not followed by "for" in this context.
 
• **Option 3:** "informed to me" is incorrect; the verb "informed" does not take "to" before the object.
 
• **Option 4:** "has told me" is grammatically correct but does not fit the tense of the original sentence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"She **told me**__ the information."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "said for me"** is incorrect because "said" is not followed by "for" in this kind of sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "informed to me"** is incorrect; the correct usage would be "informed me" without the preposition "to."
 
• **Option 4: "has told me"** is not appropriate because the present perfect tense does not match the context of the original sentence.
